items.title: Practical Guide to RNA Sequencing Analysis in Aging Research
items.description: Aging is accompanied by widespread changes in gene expression, which underlie functional and structural declines in organisms over time. Transcriptome analysis, including RNA sequencing, has become an essential approach in modern research on biological processes, including aging, but remains challenging for many experimental scientists. Here, we provide a practical protocol for RNA sequencing analysis for aging research.

items.title: Two-Step Crystallization Process Strategy for Cannabidiol Isolation at Higher Yields
items.description: We describe a Two-step DMA-MediAted Crystallization method (2DMAC-method) for the first time. items.title: Pallidal deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease: indications for target selection and perceived outcomes at two centers
items.description: We retrospectively reviewed Parkinson's disease patients undergoing GPi-DBS at two academic centers to characterize clinical rationale for target selection. GPi was most commonly selected for dyskinesia, followed by dystonia and neuropsychiatric considerations, with clinicians reporting sustained subjective improvement in hyperkinetic symptoms at one year.

items.title: Positive emotional contagion by laughter-like 50-kHz ultrasonic vocalizations in rats
items.description: Rats display advanced empathic abilities, yet current research is focused on empathy toward negative affect, largely neglecting positive affective states.
